policy.dashInterpretation: A dash means the static workbench rule found no missing repository artifact. It does not prove candidate-specific release readiness.
policy.completionFormula: Count present release proofs divided by all listed release proofs; no hidden weights.
policy.agentRule: Do not change missing to present without a resolvable artifact for this exact release version and candidate.

releaseEvidence.risk: Local evidence does not prove the final candidate on hosted or cross-plane substrates.
releaseEvidence.action: Run hosted CI and the Linux/Windows cross-plane reproducibility and corroboration workflows for the final commit.

proofs.evidence: Pinned test control and complete test command
Generated gate inventory and correspondence graph

releaseEvidence.risk: The candidate is local-only and has no immutable release, shared lineage, or closeout proof.
releaseEvidence.action: After signed PASS, publish the branch, merge with preserved ancestry, create the target-main GitHub Release, and back-merge to develop.

proofs.evidence: Version authority and mandatory precommit gate

releaseEvidence.risk: Requirement correspondence is proven locally, but the new behavior has no signed human acceptance.
releaseEvidence.action: Stage the exact VSIX on the disposable reviewer and retain a signed verdict that explicitly covers the risk scorecard and AGENTS guidance.

releaseEvidence.risk: The decisions and correspondence graph are current, but the release architecture change is not human-accepted.
releaseEvidence.action: Review ADR-0078/ADR-0079 in the exact candidate and bind approval or requested changes to the signed verdict.

proofs.evidence: 79 registered ADR baseline with current overview mapping

releaseEvidence.risk: Static documents are complete, but hosted links and human usability of generated AGENTS remain unproven.
releaseEvidence.action: Run hosted link checking and have the human reviewer use the generated AGENTS risk actions without hidden setup.

proofs.evidence: Versioned AGENTS with pinned workbench and forward risk actions

releaseEvidence.risk: Definition-of-done structure exists, but the candidate has not crossed the human, cross-plane, canonical-release, or Marketplace gates.
releaseEvidence.action: Do not publish. Obtain signed PASS, cross-plane attestation/quorum/composite, canonical GitHub Release, then byte-identical Marketplace prerelease and closeout.

proofs.evidence: Every experiment is RTM-governed or has an explicit lifecycle and production boundary
